name: duopore-public-relocation-household-budget
description: See whether your expected household costs fit your income after a move.

interface.longDescription: See whether your expected household costs fit your income after a move. Enter recurring costs, net income and the reserve you want to keep. Turn the costs into monthly amounts and see what is left or missing. Use one currency. The app uses your figures; it does not look up local living costs, tax or exchange rates.
defaultPrompt: Build a monthly household budget for my move from these figures.
What is left after these costs and my chosen reserve?

positive.prompt: Use Relocation Monthly Budget with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs.
